rules.text: it loads one trusted GitHub issue, creates a reviewed Sandcastle branch, and never creates or merges pull requests automatically.

check.how: grep for gh pr create/merge or pulls API calls

rules.text: Keep this repository's drop-in workflow intentionally small

question.instructions: How much does this change grow the drop-in workflow beyond loading one issue and producing one reviewed branch?
criteria: no new scope; fixes or trims existing behaviour
small addition directly serving the one-issue flow
adds a new option, mode, or module
adds several new features or a new workflow
